outcome: Prove operating-system enforced workspace write confinement with a rootless user and mount namespace, unprivileged, with a positive control showing the same outside write succeeding without the namespace, and evidence recording the kernel version and a non-skipped execution.
non_goals: Do not require privileges beyond unprivileged user namespaces; where the executing kernel forbids them, run in a container or a virtual machine as an alternative site and never count a skip as a pass
Do not claim operating-system enforced confinement from a convention check alone
Do not retry a varying result into a pass

transitions.reason: the M3 gate does not require OS-enforced confinement because the shared runner cannot grant the privilege; the M4 gate does

the containment proof needs any child process rather than an AI Provider, and a rootless user and mount namespace was measured to refuse an outside write with a read-only filesystem error while the same write succeeds without the namespace; the V2-017 dependency is therefore removed and the M4 branch no longer waits on the real Provider

a write outside the workspace is refused by the kernel with a read-only filesystem error under an unprivileged user and mount namespace, the same write succeeds without the namespace as a positive control, the probe refuses to start a child when the namespace is unavailable rather than falling back silently, and the process group semantics are untouched
